{{Short description|Combination puzzle by András Végh}}
{{Infobox toy|name=Puck puzzle|type=[[Combination puzzle]]|from=1980|to=present|inventor=András Végh|image=Puck137 (cropped).JPG|caption=The Puck}}

The '''Puck puzzle''' ([[Hungarian language|Hungarian]]: ''Kép Korong''), also known as '''[[Picture disc|Picture Disc]]''', is a [[combination puzzle]] invented in 1980 by Hungarian [[physicist]] András Végh.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.jaapsch.net/puzzles/kepkorong.htm|title = Kep Korong / Rubik's Cheese}}</ref> The disc shaped puzzle consists of 2 central pieces: the inner disc, and segments forming a ring around the inner disc. The number of segments is an even number, most commonly six, eight, or twelve. The outer ring can be rotated around the central disc, similar to a wheel being rotated around its [[axis of rotation|axis]]. The two parts of the central disc can also be rotated, together with the attached ring.
With these operations, the combination of the parts can be changed. The goal of the game is to obtain a specific combination, such as forming a picture or ordering a sequence of numbers on the segments.<ref>	Puck puzzle patent description (search ('Keresés') for Azonosító: 184418 ): „Logikai gerezd játék”; ügyiratszám: 831/81, lajstromszám: 184418, bejelentés napja: 1981.04.01.,  Szellemi Tulajdon Nemzeti Hivatala e-kutatás: [http://epub.hpo.hu/e-kutatas/?lang=HU Szabadalmi leírás] (pdf).</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://veghandras.webnode.hu/jatek-sport/buvos-korong/|title=Bűvös korong :: Veghandras}}</ref><ref>	Szentiványi Tibor: Egy új logikai játék a PUCK, Rubik nemzetközi játékmagazin, 2/1983 szám, (32-34). oldal.</ref>
